items: [INSTANT 30% CAPACITY EXPANSION] Effortlessly transform this 25L daily tote into a 33L travel weekender with a bottom unzip. Perfect as a TSA approved personal item, it provides extra space for clothes or souvenirs, eliminating the need for extra luggage.

[40OZ TUMBLER HOLDER & HYDRATION] Specifically engineered with an internal elastic pocket to fit 40 oz tumblers with handles (Stanley, Yeti compatible). Keep your large water bottle upright and secure, preventing leaks near your 15.6 inch laptop and tech.

[SMART ORGANIZATION FOR WORK] Weighing only 1.4 lbs, this professional work bag features a dedicated padded laptop sleeve and hidden anti-theft pocket. Ideal for teachers and nurses, it keeps daily essentials indexed for quick access during busy shifts.

[WASHABLE & WATER RESISTANT] Crafted from signature heavy-duty polyester, this machine washable tote is built for daily rigors. Unlike canvas, it maintains its structured shape after washing, making it the perfect low-maintenance solution for gym, office, or beach.

[HANDS-FREE TRAVEL SOLUTION] The integrated trolley sleeve slides securely over luggage handles for stress-free terminal navigation. Whether for business travel or weekend getaways, this versatile handbag ensures mobility is your top priority.
